## Documentation checklist (required)

- [ ] Updated `README.md` when player-facing features, controls, setup, or known limits changed, **or noted why no README change is needed**.
- [ ] Updated relevant `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/GAME_DESIGN.md`, `docs/PHYSICS.md`, and/or `docs/TESTING.md` as appropriate.
- [ ] Added an entry under `Unreleased` (or the relevant milestone) in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Documented new inputs, exported parameters, tuning defaults, and compatibility requirements when applicable.
- [ ] Recorded validation results and any untested behavior accurately, without claiming that headless tests prove driving feel.
- [ ] Verified that documentation distinguishes **implemented** functionality from **planned** ideas.

If a documentation file truly does not need changes, explain why here rather than checking it without review.

**Documentation impact / exceptions:**

## Merge readiness

- [ ] Changes are appropriately scoped.
- [ ] Relevant automated and manual tests were completed, or blockers are documented.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are included in this PR.
- [ ] No secrets or machine-specific absolute paths were committed.
- [ ] If GitHub Actions is touched: free public-repository **standard** runners only; no premium/paid runners, uploaded artifacts, workflow caches, or third-party paid services; private-repository job guard verified (or explain why not applicable).

> Project policy: documentation changes belong in the same PR as code changes. This template is a review checklist; automated enforcement can be added later.
